class="article page no-article-survey" sc-render-smart-button="false" itemscope=""> <section class="article-container" data-stats-ve="35"><h1>Use Deep Research in Gemini Apps</h1><div class="article-content-container"><div class="cc"><div class="no-margin"><p>You can conduct in-depth and real-time research on almost any subject with Deep Research in Gemini Apps. By default, Gemini includes Google Search as a source for your research. You can change or add other sources, like your personal Gmail or Drive, for your research. You can also upload files and add NotebookLM notebooks.&nbsp;<a href="https://gemini.google/overview/deep-research" rel="noopener" target="_blank">Learn more about Deep Research</a>.</p>
</div>

<p><strong>Tip:</strong> If you have a Google AI Ultra plan, Deep Research reports may include visuals like charts, diagrams, schematics, and interactive simulators. <a href="#visuals" rel="noopener">Learn more about visuals and animations</a>.</p>

<h2>What you need</h2>

<div><p>To use Deep Research, you need to:</p>

<ul class="no-margin">
  <li><strong>Be 18 or over.</strong></li>
</ul>

<div class="no-margin"><ul class="no-margin">
  <li><strong>Be signed in to the Gemini app.</strong> <a href="/gemini/answer/13278668" rel="noopener">Learn how to sign in to Gemini Apps</a>.</li>
</ul>
</div>
</div>

<h2>About Deep Research models &amp; limits</h2>
<a class="zippy" id="dr_models" name="dr_models">Deep Research models</a>

<div>
  <div class="no-margin">Google AI Pro and Google AI Ultra users can generate reports using Pro for even higher quality. All users can use Thinking for their reports. <a href="/gemini/answer/13275745#switch_modes&amp;switch_model" rel="noopener">Learn how to switch between models</a>.</div>
</div>
<a class="zippy" id="dr_limits" name="dr_limits">Deep Research limits</a>

<div>
  <div class="no-margin"><p>In Gemini Apps, there are limits for:</p>

<ul>
  <li>Daily research requests</li>
  <li>Number of research requests you can run at the same time</li>
</ul>

<p>If you’re close to your limit, Gemini Apps notifies you how many research requests are left for the day.</p>

<p>Google AI Pro and Google AI Ultra users get higher limits for how many research reports they can create.&nbsp;If you would like to create more research reports, learn <a href="/gemini/answer/16275805" rel="noopener">more about limits</a> and <a href="/gemini/answer/14517446" rel="noopener">how to upgrade</a>.</p>
</div>
</div>

<gkms-context-selector id="16035593"></gkms-context-selector><h2>Start a Deep Research report</h2>

<div class="no-margin"><ol>
  <li>On your computer, go to <a href="https://gemini.google.com" rel="noopener" target="_blank">gemini.google.com</a>.</li>
  <li>In the text box, click <strong>Add Files&nbsp;</strong><img src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/ZnxIaQhn2e_7LrN9FuAXtp5YSjXPfkqyIdYba4XV438cpOg3dPV0X00A52NEtfgJVqc=h36" width="auto" height="18" alt="" data-mime-type="image/png" data-alt-src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/ZnxIaQhn2e_7LrN9FuAXtp5YSjXPfkqyIdYba4XV438cpOg3dPV0X00A52NEtfgJVqc"> <img src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/3_l97rr0GvhSP2XV5OoCkV2ZDTIisAOczrSdzNCBxhIKWrjXjHucxNwocghoUa39gw=h36" width="auto" height="18" alt="and then" data-mime-type="image/png" data-alt-src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/3_l97rr0GvhSP2XV5OoCkV2ZDTIisAOczrSdzNCBxhIKWrjXjHucxNwocghoUa39gw"> <strong>Deep Research</strong> <img src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/6UOI71bgTu1T35sPvcadFiKT07qavL6nzPa_sn_uEaZ5E7rEAoVP7mbaAF4q4HWzdfg=h36" width="auto" height="18" alt="" data-mime-type="image/png" data-alt-src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/6UOI71bgTu1T35sPvcadFiKT07qavL6nzPa_sn_uEaZ5E7rEAoVP7mbaAF4q4HWzdfg">.</li>
  <li>(Optional)&nbsp;To upload files or an image with your prompt, click<strong>&nbsp;Add Files&nbsp;</strong><img src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/ZnxIaQhn2e_7LrN9FuAXtp5YSjXPfkqyIdYba4XV438cpOg3dPV0X00A52NEtfgJVqc=h36" width="auto" height="18" alt="" data-mime-type="image/png" data-alt-src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/ZnxIaQhn2e_7LrN9FuAXtp5YSjXPfkqyIdYba4XV438cpOg3dPV0X00A52NEtfgJVqc"> <img src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/3_l97rr0GvhSP2XV5OoCkV2ZDTIisAOczrSdzNCBxhIKWrjXjHucxNwocghoUa39gw=h36" width="auto" height="18" alt="and then" data-mime-type="image/png" data-alt-src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/3_l97rr0GvhSP2XV5OoCkV2ZDTIisAOczrSdzNCBxhIKWrjXjHucxNwocghoUa39gw"><strong>&nbsp;Files</strong> <img src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/yviX2yYxh3Wj4AC82NrkHltBj5wIKEfh0-578nvdHzGkBYgDPfbIhsB6xWIKMHpfA0z_=h36" width="auto" height="18" alt="" data-mime-type="image/png" data-alt-src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/yviX2yYxh3Wj4AC82NrkHltBj5wIKEfh0-578nvdHzGkBYgDPfbIhsB6xWIKMHpfA0z_">.
    <ul>
      <li><a href="/gemini/answer/14903178" rel="noopener">Learn more about uploading files in Gemini Apps</a>.</li>
    </ul>
  </li>
  <li>(Optional)&nbsp;To choose the sources for your research, click <strong>Sources</strong> and select the sources you want to include, like Gmail or Drive.
    <ul>
      <li>Other Google services, like Gmail and Drive, are only available if the Google Workspace app is connected to Gemini Apps. <a href="/gemini/answer/15229592" rel="noopener">Learn how to connect Google Workspace to Gemini Apps</a>.</li>
      <li>Google Search is included as a source by default. To limit your research to other selected sources, deselect Google Search.</li>
    </ul>
  </li>
  <li>In the text box, enter a question or prompt that explains what you want to research.</li>
  <li>Click <strong>Submit</strong> <img src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/qlOH_KBmIELN9rCh2FBo4YALcMaIwgwsheZ0DaWz2N6w0ZoY6_nHRfukCX8kR-Sqxqpa=h36" width="auto" height="18" alt="" data-mime-type="image/png" data-alt-src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/qlOH_KBmIELN9rCh2FBo4YALcMaIwgwsheZ0DaWz2N6w0ZoY6_nHRfukCX8kR-Sqxqpa">.
    <ul>
      <li>Gemini will create a research plan for your topic.</li>
      <li>To update the research plan before you create a report, click <strong>Edit plan</strong>.</li>
    </ul>
  </li>
  <li>Click <strong>Start research</strong>.</li>
  <li>When your report is ready, click <strong>Open</strong>.</li>
</ol>
</div>

<div class="no-margin"><p><strong>Tips:</strong></p>

<ul>
  <li>It usually takes about 5-10 minutes to generate the report since Gemini analyzes many sources. For more complex reports, it may take longer.</li>
  <li>While you wait for the report, you can leave the chat. When it’s ready, Gemini will notify you:
    <ul>
      <li>In the web app: Next to the chat thread with your completed report.</li>
      <li>In the mobile app: As a notification on your device. The notification may appear when your device is locked depending on your settings.</li>
    </ul>
  </li>
</ul>
</div>

<div class="no-margin"><a class="zippy" id="visuals" name="visuals">About visuals &amp; animations in reports</a>
<div>
  <p><strong>Important:</strong> For now, this feature isn’t available if you include any Google Workspace services, like Gmail and Drive, as a source.</p>

  <div class="no-margin"><p>With a Google AI Ultra plan, Deep Research reports can include animations and visuals. These visuals help illustrate complex data and research findings, and make reports more comprehensive and easier to understand.</p>

<p>Visuals are included directly in the report and can include:</p>

<ul>
  <li>Charts</li>
  <li>Diagrams</li>
  <li>Interactive simulators</li>
</ul>
</div>
</div>
</div>

<h2>Find your research reports</h2>

<div class="no-margin"><p><strong>Important:</strong> You can only find past research reports if your Keep Activity setting is on. <a href="/gemini/answer/13278892" rel="noopener">Learn how to manage Gemini Apps activity</a>.</p>
</div>

<div class="no-margin"><ol>
  <li>Go to <a href="https://gemini.google.com" rel="noopener" target="_blank">gemini.google.com</a>.</li>
  <li>If your chats are hidden, at the top, click Menu <img src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/i01saHUGHw8IhP8PTa2mHFfoiHvI7DfwMUlo09TddkQVihnfTd8X1qYyxsCWvWIGs6c=h36" width="auto" height="18" alt="Menu" data-mime-type="image/png" data-alt-src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/i01saHUGHw8IhP8PTa2mHFfoiHvI7DfwMUlo09TddkQVihnfTd8X1qYyxsCWvWIGs6c">.</li>
  <li>Under “<strong>Recent</strong>,” find your research chat.</li>
</ol>
</div>

<div class="no-margin"><h2>Listen to your research report</h2>

<div><ol>
  <li>Go to <a href="https://gemini.google.com" rel="noopener" target="_blank">gemini.google.com</a>.</li>
  <li>If your chats are hidden, at the top, click Menu <img src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/i01saHUGHw8IhP8PTa2mHFfoiHvI7DfwMUlo09TddkQVihnfTd8X1qYyxsCWvWIGs6c=h36" width="auto" height="18" alt="Menu" data-mime-type="image/png" data-alt-src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/i01saHUGHw8IhP8PTa2mHFfoiHvI7DfwMUlo09TddkQVihnfTd8X1qYyxsCWvWIGs6c">.</li>
  <li>Under “<strong>Recent</strong>,” select the chat with your research report.</li>
  <li>On the right in the Canvas panel, click <strong>Create</strong>&nbsp;<img src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/3_l97rr0GvhSP2XV5OoCkV2ZDTIisAOczrSdzNCBxhIKWrjXjHucxNwocghoUa39gw=h36" width="auto" height="18" alt="and then" data-mime-type="image/png" data-alt-src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/3_l97rr0GvhSP2XV5OoCkV2ZDTIisAOczrSdzNCBxhIKWrjXjHucxNwocghoUa39gw"><strong>&nbsp;</strong>Audio Overview <img src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/o70Fn37KLmLxmOkxTki0N2H-tOz2ONPXUi2w1j3g2y3CnvSrnAwQZI4Cf2I47pKVth74=h36" width="auto" height="18" alt="" data-mime-type="image/png" data-alt-src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/o70Fn37KLmLxmOkxTki0N2H-tOz2ONPXUi2w1j3g2y3CnvSrnAwQZI4Cf2I47pKVth74">.</li>
</ol>
</div>

<p><strong>Tip:</strong> <a href="/gemini/answer/16047373" rel="noopener" target="_blank">Learn more about Audio Overviews</a>.</p>
</div>

<h2>Visualize your research report</h2>

<div class="no-margin"><ol>
  <li>Go to <a href="https://gemini.google.com" rel="noopener" target="_blank">gemini.google.com</a>.</li>
  <li>If your chats are hidden, at the top, click Menu <img src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/i01saHUGHw8IhP8PTa2mHFfoiHvI7DfwMUlo09TddkQVihnfTd8X1qYyxsCWvWIGs6c=h36" width="auto" height="18" alt="Menu" data-mime-type="image/png" data-alt-src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/i01saHUGHw8IhP8PTa2mHFfoiHvI7DfwMUlo09TddkQVihnfTd8X1qYyxsCWvWIGs6c">.</li>
  <li>Under “<strong>Recent</strong>,” select the chat with your research report.</li>
  <li>On the right in the Canvas panel, click <strong>Create.</strong></li>
  <li>To create a custom visualization based on the report, enter the description as a prompt in the&nbsp;text box.</li>
</ol>
</div>

<h2>Share, export, or copy your research report</h2>

<div class="no-margin"><ol>
  <li>Go to <a href="https://gemini.google.com" rel="noopener" target="_blank">gemini.google.com</a>.</li>
  <li>If your chats are hidden, at the top, click Menu <img src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/i01saHUGHw8IhP8PTa2mHFfoiHvI7DfwMUlo09TddkQVihnfTd8X1qYyxsCWvWIGs6c=h36" width="auto" height="18" alt="Menu" data-mime-type="image/png" data-alt-src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/i01saHUGHw8IhP8PTa2mHFfoiHvI7DfwMUlo09TddkQVihnfTd8X1qYyxsCWvWIGs6c">.</li>
  <li>Under “<strong>Recent</strong>,” select the chat with your research report.</li>
  <li>On the right in the Canvas panel, click Share &amp; export&nbsp;<img src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/QqVZ3ESyW-OTWnmILv3irGUfGmphnn35oCcv4o0W5nsOc8MSu4zr0RRUoY-6TnY9XcA=h36" width="auto" height="18" alt="" data-mime-type="image/png" data-alt-src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/QqVZ3ESyW-OTWnmILv3irGUfGmphnn35oCcv4o0W5nsOc8MSu4zr0RRUoY-6TnY9XcA"><strong>.</strong></li>
  <li>Select how you want to share or export the report.&nbsp;
    <ul>
      <li>To share the report, click&nbsp;Share Canvas <img src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/QqVZ3ESyW-OTWnmILv3irGUfGmphnn35oCcv4o0W5nsOc8MSu4zr0RRUoY-6TnY9XcA=h36" width="auto" height="18" alt="" data-mime-type="image/png" data-alt-src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/QqVZ3ESyW-OTWnmILv3irGUfGmphnn35oCcv4o0W5nsOc8MSu4zr0RRUoY-6TnY9XcA">.</li>
      <li>To export the report, click Export to Docs <img src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/v4J8kBQH2vIGX1Mfv7trThykKZHer-XrMN6rYKyRxnC_qtFGJcDFOHSCHFyq_ppzLVa6=h36" width="auto" height="18" alt="" data-mime-type="image/png" data-alt-src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/v4J8kBQH2vIGX1Mfv7trThykKZHer-XrMN6rYKyRxnC_qtFGJcDFOHSCHFyq_ppzLVa6">.</li>
      <li>To copy the report text, click Copy Contents <img src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/R3rajf4zLqVR7rsKlEZA7UOxKS2vVmvnClqoMv89rZ8QhD6OqBvz5s3G1OwpTZSRwXQ=h36" width="auto" height="18" alt="" data-mime-type="image/png" data-alt-src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/R3rajf4zLqVR7rsKlEZA7UOxKS2vVmvnClqoMv89rZ8QhD6OqBvz5s3G1OwpTZSRwXQ">.</li>
    </ul>
  </li>
</ol>
</div>
